crossRefs.note: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.

translations.web: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
translations.bsb: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.
translations.kjv: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
translations.asv: Where there is no counsel, purposes are disappointed; But in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
